integrity: The universal classification is proved analytically. Exhaustive finite enumeration through order 9 is used only as a stress test. Literature coverage was checked against the initiating paper, the foundational fort-hypergraph paper, broad literature searches, and a semantic literature index; residual risk from poorly indexed prior work is disclosed.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to finite simple complete multipartite graphs with at least two parts; does not classify compatible fort collections or all nonminimal forts.
title: Minimal forts of complete multipartite graphs have rank at most three
